mapper.insert: insert into chain_word_log (chain_room_id, member_id, chain_word_id, attempted_word, turn_no, is_valid, invalid_reason_code) values (#{chainRoomId}, #{memberId}, #{chainWordId}, #{attemptedWord}, #{turnNo}, #{isValid}, #{invalidReasonCode})
mapper.select: select l.chain_word_log_id as chainWordLogId, l.chain_room_id as chainRoomId, l.member_id as memberId, l.chain_word_id as chainWordId, l.attempted_word as attemptedWord, l.turn_no as turnNo, l.is_valid as isValid, l.invalid_reason_code as invalidReasonCode, l.reg_date as regDate, m.member_name as memberName from chain_word_log l join member m on m.member_id = l.member_id where l.chain_room_id = #{chainRoomId} order by l.chain_word_log_id asc
